sequence: verify registry manifest sha256, task/suite entry and the selected state file (every reset)
env.set_init_state(selected state) once; its returned observation is used
reset.seed_to_init_state_index: test seeds 1-50 -> original LIBERO init file slots 0-49; development seeds 51-65 -> common development states 0-14 (one file each); no modulo, no cross-partition reuse
reset.scope: common environment fix for all new comparisons; not a SAM2/streaming method factor
supersedes: reset-then-set_init_state-then-reset, which discarded the selected initial state (fixed in libero-reset-v2-2026-10-10)
(seed - 1) % 50, which made development seeds 51-65 reuse test states 1-15 (libero-reset-v2-2026-10-10)
reset.source_sha256: recorded by the outer coordinator at freeze

initial_states.approved: 2026-10-10 by the user: each task's init file has only 50 states; 15 fixed development states are added for seeds 51-65

test.source: original LIBERO-Pro init file of each task, byte/sha256 unchanged, slot = seed - 1

development.source: pre-generated once by the outer operator with scripts/libero/prepare_common_initial_states.py; one .npy per seed; slot = seed - 51

initial_states.duplicate_state: recorded in the manifest and the generation fails; no seed is substituted or resampled

generation.tasks_and_files: the suite's own registration (task index, definition file, init file) with sha256, checked against the outer asset preflight
generation.env_args: same as FrankaLiberoEnv: JOINT_POSITION, 800x512 cameras with depth, control_freq 20, horizon 4000
generation.capture: env.get_sim_state() right after one env.reset(); 0 settling steps before capture
generation.resume: same identity only; recorded states are never regenerated or overwritten; in-flight seeds are marked sampling

initial_states.manifest: initial_state_manifest.json: schema aspire-libero-common-initial-states-v1, partitions, seed mapping, per-task definition/test file paths and sha256, 50 test-state digests, per development state path/file sha256/array digest/shape/dtype/finite/sampling seed, source file hashes, simulator package versions
initial_states.location: an outer runtime-assets directory outside the source checkout, generated once and shared read-only by every method and cell of this line
initial_states.trial_binding: case.initial_state_manifest + initial_state_manifest_sha256 -> ASPIRE_LIBERO_INITIAL_STATE_MANIFEST/_SHA256 and ASPIRE_LIBERO_INITIAL_STATE_REQUIRED=1 in the trial process only
initial_states.cpu_test_fake_fixture: may omit the registry; every identity then records the legacy loader and it is never evidence
initial_states.solver_access: none: the guard refuses the statepack, its manifest and the generator; authored code may not call get_sim_state/set_init_state/init_states, load npy/npz/pt/pkl or reference bddl/xml/urdf/init files; state contents never enter the policy, world or solver namespace
